functions.name: host_cmd_poll
functions.plate:
Called from the main loop when host_cmd_pending (0x13400) is set. Scans all 32 slots at 0x13200 (r10 = slot, r11 = count): a nonzero code byte runs host_cmd_exec(r0 = code, r10 = slot). For EVERY slot the low byte of r0 is stored to byte 1 of the log entry cmd_log_cur (0x4994) and the slot's code byte is cleared; then host_cmd_pending = 0.
Quirk: empty slots store r0 = 0, so in any batch of < 32 commands the last command's logged result is overwritten with 0.

functions.name: host_cmd_exec
functions.plate:
Logs the command (bytes 0..11 + ticks_since_cmd, then cleared) at 0x14800 + cmd_log_ofs, advances the offset by 16 mod 0x800 and writes a 0xFFFFFFFF end marker; then dispatches: 0x00-0x3F via hcmd_jt_00_3f (0x4A44), 0x80-0x8F via hcmd_jt_80_8f (0x4B44). 0x40-0x7F / 0x90-0xFF return r0 = code*4.
Result (r0, low byte logged by host_cmd_poll) per case, see the case labels hcmd_NN_* (the 'callee r0' cases were traced: shot helpers leave port&7, stream helpers [2] (0x25/0x26: [2]&~0x10), stop_all = g_pcm_slot[15].kind, 0x1C bad mode = old err; 0x8F non-SEGA = first mismatching byte).
Implemented: 01-08 0A-0C 0E 0F (MIDI), 11-1C 1E 1F (one-shot), 21 22 25-2B 2E 2F (PCM stream), 35 36 3E (GD-DA), 80-8A 8E 8F (global; 82-8F bodies in fx.c). Unused: 00 09 0D 10 1D 20 23 24 2C 2D 30-34 37-3D 3F 8B-8D.

functions.name: port_reset_prm
functions.plate: Host 0x0E helper: resets one port's host parameters: vol/pan target+current 0x80, pitch/speed target+current 0x8000, all fade interval/count/step 0, direct_lvl/fx_send 0x80, SeqPlayer.tempo_scale = 0x4000. Returns 0. Dirty flags are not set. Entered by fall-through from hcmd_0e_midi_reset_prm (0x5094) and called per port from 0x512C.

labels.name: cmd_log_cur
labels.comment: scratch: log entry of the command being executed (host_cmd_poll stores the result at +1)

labels.name: hcmd_jt_00_3f
labels.comment: jump table: 64 x 'b case', host codes 0x00-0x3F (index code*4)

labels.name: hcmd_jt_80_8f
labels.comment: jump table: 16 x 'b case', host codes 0x80-0x8F (index (code*4)&0x1FF < 0x40)

labels.name: hcmd_01_bank_error
labels.comment: bad SMSB bank: status |= 0x80, err_hi |= r1

labels.name: hcmd_11_bank_error
labels.comment: bad SOSB bank: player flags |= 0x80, g_shot_status[port].err_hi |= r1

labels.name: p_exts0_efsdl
labels.comment: 0x802041: high byte of DSP_OUT(16) (EXTS0 = CD left)

labels.name: mono_flag
labels.comment: 0 stereo, 0xFFFFFFFF mono (host 0x8A); host 0x81 clamps MVOL to 13 when set

labels.name: ticks_since_cmd
labels.comment: ++ every 4 ms (0x6698); logged as word 3 of each command-log entry and cleared

comments.text: Unused host command (codes 0x00,0x09,0x0D,0x10,0x20,0x23,0x24,0x2C,0x2D,0x30-0x34,0x37-0x3D,0x3F,0x8B-0x8D): mov pc,lr, result r0 = code*4 (table offset).

host 0x01 sdMidiPlay: [2]=port [3]=SMSB bank [4]=song [5]=prio<<3.
Checks bank table 0x14000+bank*8 ("SMSB", version 1, "ENDB" at size-4) -> seq_play(port,song,prio,bank=r12); PortState.status = (status&0xFC)|(state&3), err = g_seq.err, bit7 = err!=0; g_seq.err = 0.
Bank error: status|=0x80, err_hi|=2/8/4, result = err_hi. Success result = port<<7.

host 0x02 sdMidiStop: [2]=port.
Keys off + frees all voices of the port (voice word0=0, AICA ctl=(ctl&0x7FF)|KYONEX), seq_stop, port status sync. Result port<<7.

host 0x03 sdMidiPause: [2]=port.
Keys off the port's voices (Voice records kept), seq_pause, port status sync. Result port<<7.

host 0x04 sdMidiContinue: [2]=port.
seq_continue, port status sync. Result port<<7.

host 0x05 sdMidiSetVol: [2]=port [3]=vol+0x80 [4..5]=fade.
PortState vol_target=[3], interval=count=fade>>3, step=|volume-target|; step and interval halved together while both >=2. fade 0: interval 0, step 0. Result 0.

host 0x06 sdMidiSetPan (lib-only): [2]=port [3]=pan+0x80 [4..5]=fade.
As 0x05 for PortState pan_* (+6..+0xA). Result 0.

host 0x07 sdMidiSetSpeed (lib-only): [2]=port [4..5]=speed*4+0x8000 [6..7]=fade.
speed_target = speed&0xFFF0 (fade also masked 0xFFF0), interval = fade>>3, step=|speed-target|&0xFFF0 halved with interval while both>=2, clamp 0xFF (fade 0 -> step 0xFF). Result 0.

host 0x08 sdMidiSetPitch: [2]=port [4..5]=pitch+0x8000 [6..7]=fade.
pitch_target = pitch&0xFFFE, interval=(fade&0xFFFE)>>3, step=|pitch-target|&0xFFFE; do-while halving (always at least once), clamp 0xFF. Result 0.
host 0x0A sdMidiSetFxLev: [2]=port [3]=lev+0x80. PortState.fx_send = [3] (no dirty flag: new notes only). Result 0.
host 0x0B sdMidiSetDrctLev (lib-only): [2]=port [3]=lev+0x80. PortState.direct_lvl = [3]. Result 0.
host 0x0C (no sd 1.00.18 API): [2]=port. seq_break_loop (SeqPlayer.loop_left = 0). Result port&7.

host 0x0E sdMidiResetPrm/ResetAllPrm (lib-only): [2]=port or 0xFF=all.
r4=&g_port[port], r6=&g_seq_player[port], falls into port_reset_prm (0x50B8). Result 0.

host 0x0F sdMidiStopAll (lib-only): no params.
Keys off + frees all 48 voices, then seq_stop + port status sync for ports 0..7. Result 8.

host 0x11 sdShotPlay: [2]=port [3]=SOSB bank [4]=data [5]=prio<<3.
Checks bank 0x14100+bank*8 ("SOSB", version 1, "ENDB") -> shot_play(port,data,prio,bank); player flags bit7 = err!=0, g_shot_status[port].err = err, err = 0. Result = new flags.
Bank error: flags|=0x80, g_shot_status[port].err_hi |= 2/8/4, result = err_hi.
host 0x12 sdShotStop (lib-only): [2]=port -> shot_stop. Result = port (r0 saved).
host 0x13 (no library API, shot pause): [2]=port -> shot_pause. Result = port.
host 0x14 (no library API, shot continue): [2]=port -> shot_continue. Result = port.
host 0x15 sdShotSetVol: [2]=port [3]=vol+0x80 [4..5]=fade -> shot_set_vol(r0,r1,r2). Result port&7 (callee masks r0; pcm_fade_calc/pcm_next_ch leave it).
host 0x16 sdShotSetPan (lib-only): [2]=port [3]=pan+0x80 [4..5]=fade -> shot_set_pan. Result port&7.

host 0x17 sdShotSetSpeed (lib-only): [2]=port [4..5]=speed+0x8000 [6..7]=fade.
PcmPlayer speed_target/interval/count/step (+0x40..+0x4A). Quirk: halving loop only runs while interval<=1 (inverted test). Clamp 0xFF. Result 0.

host 0x18 sdShotSetPitch: [2]=port [4..5]=pitch+0x8000 [6..7]=fade.
As 0x17 for PcmPlayer pitch_* (+0x4C..+0x56). Result 0.
host 0x19 sdShotSetFxCh (lib-only): [2]=port [3]=fx_in_ch [4]=base_lev+0x80 -> shot_set_fx_ch. Result port&7 (r0 masked by the callee, untouched after).
host 0x1A sdShotSetFxLev: [2]=port [3]=lev+0x80 -> shot_set_fx_lvl ([4] loaded into r2 but unused). Result port&7.
host 0x1B sdShotSetDrctLev (lib-only): [2]=port [3]=lev+0x80 -> shot_set_direct_lvl. Result port&7.

host 0x1C (no library API): [2]=port [3]=mode 0..2 [4..7]=param -> shot_set_loop_mode. Result port&7; mode > 2: callee exits via pcm_err_exit (0x81C4), which pops THIS routine's saved lr and returns straight to host_cmd_poll with r0 = the player's old err byte (before |= 0x20).
host 0x1E sdShotResetPrm/ResetAllPrm (lib-only): [2]=port, 0xFF -> shot_reset_prm_all. Result port&7, or 0xFF for all.
host 0x1F sdShotStopAll: no params -> shot_stop_all. Result = g_pcm_slot[15].kind (r0 = last kind byte loaded by the slot scan, read before the slot is released).

host 0x21 sdPstmPlay: [2]=port|0x80 stereo|fmt<<4 [3]=base vol [4..5]=freq (OCT/FNS) [6]=prio<<3 [7]=SPSR bank ch0 [8]=SPSR bank ch1.
pstm_play(r0=port, r1=fmt, r2=[7]|[8]<<8|stereo<<16, r3=[3], r4=freq, r5=[6]); exported flags of both channels &= 0xE8; per channel player: flags bit7=err!=0, status +0x1C=err, err=0. Result 0.
host 0x22 sdPstmStop: [2]=port -> pstm_stop; exported flags of both channels &= 0xE8. Result = port.
host 0x25 sdPstmSetVol: [2]=port|0x20 ch0|0x10 ch1 [3]=vol0 [4..5]=fade0 [7]=vol1 [8..9]=fade1 -> pstm_set_vol(r0,r1,r2,r4,r5). Result [2]&~0x10 (pcm_next_ch clears the ch1 bit in r0).
host 0x26 sdPstmSetPan: layout as 0x25 with pan values -> pstm_set_pan(r0,r1,r2,r4,r5). Result [2]&~0x10.
host 0x27 sdPstmSetSpeed (lib-only): [2]=port [4..5]=speed+0x8000 [6..7]=fade. As 0x17, stored in both channel players (+0x40, +0x98). Result 0.
host 0x28 sdPstmSetPitch (lib-only): as 0x27 for pitch (+0x4C, +0xA4). Result 0.
host 0x29 sdPstmSetFxCh: [2]=port [3]=fx_in_ch [4]=base_lev+0x80 -> pstm_set_fx_ch. Result [2] (callee masks the port into r8, r0 untouched).
host 0x2A sdPstmSetFxLev: [2]=port [3]=lev+0x80 -> pstm_set_fx_lvl. Result [2].
host 0x2B sdPstmSetDrctLev (lib-only): [2]=port [3]=lev+0x80 -> pstm_set_direct_lvl. Result [2].
host 0x2E sdPstmResetPrm/ResetAllPrm (lib-only): [2]=port, 0xFF -> pstm_reset_prm_all. Result [2] (0xFF for all).
host 0x2F sdPstmStopAll (lib-only) -> pstm_stop_all. Result = g_pcm_slot[15].kind as read by the slot scan (as 0x1F).
host 0x35 sdGddaSetVol (lib-only): [2]=l [3]=r (vol*2). Byte writes [2]>>4 -> 0x802041, [3]>>4 -> 0x802045 (EFSDL of EXTS0/1). Result 0.
host 0x36 sdGddaSetPan (lib-only): [2]=l+0x80 [3]=r+0x80. (x>>3)-16 -> AICA sign/magnitude pan, byte writes to 0x802040/0x802044 (EFPAN). Result 0.
host 0x3E sdGddaResetPrm (lib-only): DSP_OUT(16)=DSP_OUT(17)=0. Result 0.

host 0x80 sdSndStopAll: [2]=[3]=[4]=[5]=1 [6]=[7]=0 from the library. Each nonzero byte enables a part:
[2] key off+free all 48 voices, seq_stop ports 0..7 (no status sync); [3] shot_stop_all; [4] pstm_stop_all; [5] DSP_OUT(16/17)=0 (GD-DA); [6] fx_prg_clear; [7] DSP_OUT(0..15)=0. Result 0.
host 0x81 sdSndSetMasterVol: [2]=(vol<<4)&0xFF. master_vol (0x13424) = [2]>>4; if mono (0x13404) clamp 13; byte write to MVOL (VER=0, MONO bit kept). Result 0.
host 0x82 sdSndSetFxOut / 2nd half of sdSndSetFxPrg: [2]=fx_out_num. See fx.c.
host 0x83 sdSndSetFxOutPrm (lib-only): [2]=out [3]=lev+0x80 [4]=pan+0x80. See fx.c.
host 0x84 sdSndSetFxPrg (1st command): [2]=fx_prg_num. Loads r0=[2] and falls into fx_prg_select (0x5C98).
host 0x86 sdMidiSendMes: [4..7] = packed event (mes[0]=data2, mes[1]=data1, mes[2]=port<<4|ch, mes[3]=type) pushed raw into the event ring (no full check). See fx.c.
host 0x87 (no library API): [2] bit0 = drum mode, [3]&7 = port; MIDI channel 10 of the port. See fx.c.
host 0x88 sdQsndSetPos: [2..9] per-slot DSP pan presets. See fx.c.
host 0x89: no-op (result 0x24).
host 0x8A sdSndSetSpace: [2]=0xFF mono / 0 stereo. See fx.c.
host 0x8E (no library API): soft reset with FIQ masked. See fx.c.
host 0x8F (no library API): [4..7]=="SEGA" -> reset and hang. See fx.c. If not "SEGA": result = the first mismatching byte (left in r0 by ldrb/cmp/movne pc,lr).
result byte -> log entry +1 (also for empty slots: r0 = 0 overwrites the last command's result)
clear only the code byte of the slot
log word 3 = ticks since previous command (slot bytes 12..15 are not logged)
end marker: next log entry = 4 x 0xFFFFFFFF
r0 = code*4: table offset, also the result of unused/rejected codes
codes 0x40-0x7F: ignored
codes 0x90-0xFF: ignored
r1 = SeqPlayer.state returned by the sequencer: play/pause bits
only the play command clears g_seq.err
abs(cur - target)
halve step and interval while both >= 2
0xFFF0 masks both speed and fade (quirk)
do-while: always halved at least once (stored step = delta/2)
quirk: exits when interval >= 2 (inverted vs. MIDI port version)
dead code: r1/r2 & 0x17 ORed into r3, which is reloaded below
mono: MVOL clamped to 13
byte write: MVOL=vol, VER=0, MONO (bit 15) untouched
result: seq_break_loop leaves r0 = port & 7 (and r0,r0,#7) - not saved here
not reached for mode > 2: pcm_err_exit popped our lr and returned to host_cmd_poll
shot_stop_all leaves r0 = g_pcm_slot[15].kind (result)
pstm_stop_all leaves r0 = g_pcm_slot[15].kind (result)
shot_set_vol leaves r0 = port & 7 (result)
pstm_set_vol leaves r0 = [2] & ~0x10 (result)
[7] == 0: return with r0 = 0
[2] == 0: skip the MIDI part
